title: Proposal: Add externalLinks, like externalDocs but allow more than one

raw.title: Proposal: Add externalLinks, like externalDocs but allow more than one
raw.body:
This proposal is a suggested approach for addressing this long-standing issue https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/issues/1034 where quite a lot of people have asked for the ability to add more than one resource at a time.

AI disclosure: talked through with Claude and got the sillier ideas out of the way before proposing this approach, but the writing is my own.

- [x] no schema changes are needed for this pull request
